items.title: Anthropic lists on Nasdaq in record IPO, raising about $81 billion
items.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the $70-78 range set at the roadshow launch on 2026-11-10. It began trading on Nasdaq as ANT on 2026-11-19 and opened at $111.50, about 34% above the IPO price. Reports say the deal was upsized to roughly 980 million shares, raising about $81.3 billion, the largest IPO on record. The stock reportedly closed at $97.17. Pricing and first-day figures come from secondary outlets.
items.why_it_matters: Largest listing on record and the first major public-market price for a frontier AI lab.

items.title: Nvidia reports $115.8B quarterly revenue and guides to $130B for Q4
items.summary: For fiscal Q3 2027 (quarter ended 2026-10-25), Nvidia reported revenue of $115.8B, up 103% year over year. Data Center revenue was $107.6B, up 110%. Q4 guidance is $130B plus or minus 3%, gross margin 71-72%, assuming no Data Center compute revenue from China. First report since Jensen Huang's CEO departure, with Colette Kress as interim CEO.
items.why_it_matters: Nvidia is the bellwether for AI infrastructure spending.

items.title: Nvidia shares slide after earnings amid export-control probe and CEO uncertainty
items.summary: After the earnings beat, Nvidia shares rose only about 4% after hours on 2026-11-17. Coverage cites leadership uncertainty and a Singapore-Malaysia export-control investigation. By 2026-11-20 the stock reportedly traded around $130.91, down 8.8% from the open. US Commerce and DOJ are reportedly investigating Singapore cloud firm Megaspeed; Malaysia is looking into AI chips imported by its Speedmatrix unit. Single-source figures.
items.why_it_matters: Strong results were outweighed by regulatory and governance risk.

items.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B Series C for AI drug discovery
items.summary: Alphabet-linked Isomorphic Labs raised a $5B Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, with Andreessen Horowitz as new investor, plus Thrive Capital, GV and CapitalG. It came about six months after a $2.1B Series B in May 2026. No valuation disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: One of the largest AI rounds outside the foundation-model labs.
